title: Teacher-Ready Constitution: package quality gets a fast standard

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.14 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

ciDeep.note: Deep proof remains release-branch or manual pre-release proof. This patch does not claim remote deep-proof success.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor review or approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The Teacher-Ready Package Constitution defines seven non-negotiable package-quality obligations from course identity through handoff clarity.
The machine-readable constitution contract names audit:constitution as the fast gate and keeps audit:gold as broad regression.
Five canonical fixtures cover clean pass, hidden digest caveat, assessment gap, discipline mismatch, and thin handoff package risks.
The constitution audit evaluates the fixture contract without provider calls and emits latest JSON and Markdown audit reports.
Focused tests pin the constitution gate so routine narrow quality releases do not require the full 40-sample gold corpus as default proof.

carryForward.next: Use the constitution as the acceptance surface for CurriculumV1 and CourseIR compiler proof before changing default generation.
